items.title: Groq raises $350M at $3.5B valuation as it pivots from AI chips to neocloud
items.note: Valuation is down from $6.9B before Nvidia poached founder Jonathan Ross and top talent in a $20B licensing deal

items.title: Microsoft merges its two Copilot apps, kills Group Chats, Deep Research and other flopped features
items.note: Consumer and business Copilot combine into one app as underperforming features retire by today, Aug 18

items.title: Opendoor launches its first-ever share buyback, raises $650M via 0% convertible notes
items.note: Repurchased 5% of shares at $3.49 each while adding $440M in growth capital to the balance sheet

items.title: Anthropic in advanced talks to buy Israeli AI startup Decart for $6 billion
items.note: Would be Anthropic's largest-ever acquisition, aimed at cutting inference costs across chip types
